ledger.claim: The trip satisfies POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) on the face of the record: EV-TRIP-00202 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-07-24T23:13:10+08:00, and EV-GPS-00202 places the driver inside the AIRPORT arrival radius of 150 m from 2026-07-24T23:12:45 — 25 seconds before that event — that being the first of 63 qualifying in-geofence fixes. Limb (b) is therefore met at or before the arrival timestamp, which is precisely what the clause demands.

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met with room to spare. The driver held position inside the geofence in a single unbroken run of 63 qualifying fixes from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05 — 620 continuous seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap, against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum. That is a surplus of 140 seconds on the strictest zone class in the schedule.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is met. The trip was terminated by the driver at 23:23:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes the limb recognises — which is after the required 480-second dwell had elapsed at 23:20:45, and the record shows no boarding event, with started_at and ended_at both null.

The arrival marker is not false, so POL-NS-05 does not disturb this fee. At the 'arrived' timestamp of 23:13:10 the driver was already stationary inside the 150 m geofence, having entered it at 23:12:45, so neither trigger in the clause is present — the driver was not more than 300 m from the pin, and the only non-zero speed in the trace belongs to the inbound leg, not to the hold. Even on a recomputation under POL-NS-05, the corrected in-geofence dwell of 620 seconds still exceeds the 480-second minimum, and limb (iii) leaves POL-NS-01 to govern.

There is no waiting-period shortfall to refund under POL-NS-06. The effective in-geofence dwell is 620 seconds against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum, and the derived shortfall is -140.0 seconds on longest_run_sec — a surplus, not a deficit — so the clause's full-refund rule is not engaged. Limb (i) accumulation is neither needed nor asserted: the hold was one continuous interval, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so limb (i) is unavailable); nothing in the driver's case depends on it.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. Limb (a) requires a rider message during the waiting window, and EV-CHAT-00202 holds exactly three messages, none of them from the rider: MSG-00202-001 is the SYSTEM arrival notice while MSG-00202-002 and MSG-00202-003 are the driver's own two messages. Limb (c) is undecidable rather than satisfied — all 88 rider fixes report 45–80 m horizontal accuracy, outside the 25 m filter, so they count as evidence of neither presence nor absence — meaning the clause could not be run in the rider's favour even if limb (a) had been met. EV-CHAT-00202 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (read_at is null on every message), and I disclose that; the issue bears only on whether the rider saw the driver's messages, not on the deciding fact of dwell.

This is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03. That clause applies only where the driver's stationary dwell lies outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius yet within 400 m of the pin; here the entire 620-second hold was inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius, and the driver's closest approach to the pin was 22.4 m. No mislocation refund arises and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable — the fee is governed by POL-NS-01 and the driver's money by POL-NS-07.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, the driver is compensated under POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, that is SGD 4.80. The anti-farming check does not trip and cannot be stretched: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 168 is 0.006, far below 0.08 — both limbs are needed and neither is remotely close. EV-DPROF-00202 is impaired at weight 0.9 on issue SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH, which I disclose; the two counters the clause names sit an order of magnitude below their thresholds, so the discount does not disturb the finding.

The charged amount is not defective under POL-NS-08(d). The fee_schedule resolution rule takes the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee: SGD 6.00 for the AIRPORT zone class against SGD 4.00 for the RYDE_X vehicle tier, so SGD 6.00 governs, produced on the zone-class dimension. That is exactly the cancellation_fee line in EV-FARE-00202, charged at 23:23:38, so there is no reconciliation failure to down-weight anything.

No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so nothing on this record is held for review. The deciding fact — dwell — is carried by EV-GPS-00202 and EV-TRIP-00202, both at weight 1.0, so no confidence cap below the 0.70 floor applies; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that limb (d) reads; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip.

ruling.explanation:
Decision on trip TRP-00202 and the disputed SGD 6.00 no-show fee, for Ms Rider (RDR-00951) and Mr Driver (DRV-00446).

THE FEE. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold, and all four do. (a) EV-TRIP-00202 records the driver's 'arrived' event at 2026-07-24T23:13:10. (b) EV-GPS-00202 places the driver inside the AIRPORT arrival radius of 150 m on 63 qualifying fixes, the first at 23:12:45 — 25 seconds before the arrived event, as limb (b) requires. (c) The driver then held position continuously for 620 seconds (23:12:45 to 23:23:05), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap, against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum — a surplus of 140 seconds. (d) The driver terminated at 23:23:20 on reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the minimum had elapsed, with no boarding event (started_at and ended_at null).

Nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply because the whole hold was inside the 150 m radius, closest approach 22.4 m. POL-NS-05 (false marker) does not apply because at 23:13:10 the driver was already stationary inside the geofence; neither trigger (over 300 m, or 15 km/h or more) is present. POL-NS-06 gives no shortfall refund: the derived shortfall is -140 seconds, a surplus, and EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the limb (i) accumulation rule is unavailable and unneeded.

THE RIDER'S CASE. I accept your account as far as the record goes: the system notice (23:13:11) and both driver messages (23:14:02, 23:19:30) carry read_at null, no in-app call was made, and EV-CHAT-00202 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE. That explains why you did not reply. But the waiting-period rule is strict liability: no limb of POL-NS-01 asks where the rider was or whether she saw the messages, and the clause that could have exonerated you, POL-NS-04, requires as limb (a) that you sent a locating or coordinating message during the window — the log holds three messages and none is yours. Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is undecidable, not satisfied or failed: 0 of 88 rider fixes pass the 25 m accuracy filter and, under POL-NS-04, that is neutral rather than adverse. Neutrality does not refund the fee.

NO ESCALATION, NO REFERRAL. None of the POL-NS-09 triggers fires. The deciding facts — arrival, dwell and the fee — are carried by EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 and EV-FARE-00202, each at weight 1.0, so no confidence cap below the 0.70 floor applies. No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 limb (d) reads. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip. The sole-evidence limb (e) is not met. POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival record is not triggered because the marker was genuine. The fee therefore holds rather than being held for review, and there is no clause-mandated referral.

DRIVER'S MONEY. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, that is SGD 4.80; the platform retains SGD 1.20. The anti-farming guard fails on both limbs: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (needs 4 or more) and 1 / 168 completed trips = 0.006 (needs above 0.08), so compensation is paid. The fare reconciles under POL-NS-08(d): the resolution rule takes the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so SGD 6.00 governs on the zone-class dimension and matches the charged line. Per POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 4.80.

WEIGHT AND CONFIDENCE. The ruling rests on EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 and EV-FARE-00202 (each weight 1.0) for arrival, dwell and the fee, and on EV-DPROF-00202 (weight 0.9, SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH) for the anti-farming guard; the lowest weight among the carriers of the ruling's facts is 0.9, so confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The driver-profile discount is immaterial because the two counters sit an order of magnitude below their thresholds. EV-CHAT-00202 (0.85, UNREAD_MESSAGE) does not carry the deciding fact. EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and carries no fact. No profile field beyond the two counters POL-NS-07 names was used as a ground of decision.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
